params.name: var
params.let: float(sum([o * o for o in offs])) / len(offs)

stem: Find the standard deviation of the values ${=setof(vals)}$, correct to two decimal places.
solution: The deviations from the mean are ${=setof(offs)}$.
The mean of their squares is $\frac{{=sum(o * o for o in offs)}}{{=len(offs)}} = {=num(round(var, 4))}$.
notes: Reproduces the hand-written family tpl:u3-2-2:stddev in generate_questions.py, item for item (decision 16 proof, tests/test_family_reproduction.py). Misconception ids are the catalogue's (seed/generated/misconceptions.json), which the live bank carries. Not loaded by anything: the live Prep-3 bank is the committed export.
